note: Triennial election of the thirteen divisions of Londonderry (Derry) rural district. 'All the retiring members of Derry Rural District Council were, at the triennial nominations, returned unopposed. This the fourth electoral period in succession in which there has been no contest' (Belfast Telegraph, 29 April 1936, p. 3); the report names no one. Ten members are recorded from the reports of the new council's first meeting (Saturday 6 June 1936), each in the division of the 1933 return. Results for 10 of 13 divisions; Ardmore, Ballymullan and Eglinton are not yet found. Filed under 2 June 1936, the polling day in Co. Londonderry. Added in the meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026. All the retiring members were returned unopposed at the nominations (Belfast Telegraph, 29 April 1936, p. 3). Division inferred from the 2 June 1933 return (Patrick Conway, Derry Journal, 1 May 1933, p. 7); the Derry Journal (8 June 1936) names the member at the first meeting of the new council, where the chairman 'was glad that no change had taken place in the Councillors during the past year'. No co-option or by-election for this division was found. Returned unopposed.
